question: KBC / Cumulant collision families: are they implemented and viscosity-controlled (path A), or must the claim be withdrawn (path B)?
path_resolution: PATH A (verify the existing implementation) — the modules src/tensorlbm/entropic_kbc.py (entropic KBC, 640 lines) and src/tensorlbm/cumulant.py (cumulant D2Q9/D3Q19/D3Q27, 1615 lines) exist and are registered in advanced_collision_contract as AVAILABLE for D3Q19 and D3Q27; the m23039 audit that declared them NOT_SUPPORTED scanned only the legacy 2-D solver path (solver.py / verification/lid_driven_cavity). Path A therefore becomes a quantitative verification, not a new implementation: no kernel code is changed unless a gate fails.

platform_frozen_criteria.dispatch_text: 路径A（实现）：KBC entropic 或 cumulant 至少其一+Taylor-Green 涡衰减验证；路径B（除名）：README/API/文档彻底清除 KBC/Cumulant 认领+负向知识登记（nkl）说明未实现与再启用条件。两路径都须交付「文档认领↔实现注册表一致性脚本」。

protocol.case: 3-D Taylor-Green vortex, periodic N^3, u = (U0 sin kx cos ky cos kz, -U0 cos kx sin ky cos kz, 0), k = 2*pi/N
protocol.analytic_anchor: kinetic energy E(t) = E0 exp(-gamma_E t), gamma_E = 6 nu k^2 (8 plane waves with |kappa|^2 = 3 k^2); nu = c_s^2 (tau - 1/2) = (tau - 1/2)/3
protocol.tau_sweep_tier_A: N = 32, tau in {0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.5} (decisive test of nu(tau))
protocol.grid_tier_B: N = 48, tau = 0.7 (Re = 24 canonical point; isolates discretisation from kernel error)
protocol.reconciliation_tier_C: N in {32, 48} with the fp32 protocol of benchmarks/pending/collision_kernels_3d_tg (tau = 0.5 + 3 U0 N/24) — same protocol that published the kbc_d3q19 FAIL, re-run to attribute it
protocol.fit_window: samples after the first two recorded ones with E/E0 > 1e-8; least squares on ln E(t)

gates.G2_exponence: R^2 of the ln E(t) fit >= 0.999
gates.G4_positivity: min f >= -1e-14 for the entropic KBC kernels

verdict_rule.kernel_REAL: G1..G4 hold at every measured (tau, N)
verdict_rule.family_REAL: every lattice the registry advertises AVAILABLE has at least one audited kernel with kernel_REAL
verdict_rule.family_WITHHELD: registered but at least one measured (tau, N) deviates by more than 3% (deviation quoted, never rounded away)
verdict_rule.path_A_PASS: KBC family REAL or CUMULANT family REAL, AND the doc-claim <-> registry consistency script passes with zero FAIL
verdict_rule.path_B_required: neither family REAL => claims must be deleted from README/API/docs and a negative-knowledge (nkl) entry filed

gates.R1: prose claim of AVAILABLE with ledger grade below REAL => FAIL
gates.R2: prose WITHHELD / not-implemented claim while ledger grade REAL => FAIL (stale withholding)
gates.R3: every registry AVAILABLE kernel must import and conserve mass/momentum to 1e-12 in one float64 collision
gates.R4: every registry family must have a ledger row
